repos.description: Python script for downloading books as PDF from Booktab software.
A python script for automating a site that downloads the book you want to read in your Downloads folder in aa pdf or Epub format.
This tool is a Windows batch/python script designed to automate the extraction, sorting, and clean-up of Scene releases, especially for 0day and eBook packs plus more!

findings.name: Added manual .nfo download mode
findings.description: simply enter one or more release names.

findings.name: Extracts missing file_id.diz from .zip archives using 7
findings.description: Zip. (fallbacks to WinRAR if 7-Zip is not installed.).

findings.name: Moves foreign
findings.description: language releases based on folder name keywords like GERMAN, FRENCH, SPANISH, etc to a _foreign folder.

findings.name: Optional logging
